description: Search long-term and holiday rentals in North Goa, India (Morjim, Arambol, Mandrem, Ashwem, Siolim...). Pass the user's request as plain text in `query`, in any language (e.g. '2BHK in Mandrem under 60k for January, quiet, with AC'), and/or explicit filters; explicit filters win. Returns up to 10 places, newest first, with monthly and nightly prices in Indian rupees, distance to the beach, amenities, photos, the date the owner last confirmed availability and a Telegram link where the user contacts the realtor. Read-only: it never books or contacts anyone.

has_video.description: Only places with a video tour.

location.description: Area, e.g. 'Mandrem'. Comma-separated for several. See get_locations.

max_distance_m.description: Max distance to the beach, metres.

query.description: The user's request in plain language, any language.

quiet.description: Only quiet places, away from roads and bars.

sort.description: Order: newest first, cheapest monthly rent first, or closest to the beach first.

stay_month.description: Month of arrival, 1-12 (prices depend on season).

type.description: 1RK, Studio, 1BHK, 2BHK, 3BHK, 4BHK, House, Bungalow, Room, Villa, Hotel. Comma-separated for several.

name: search_properties

applied_filters.description: Filters actually used (parsed from query + explicit).

count.description: How many places match in total.

error.description: Set instead of the result when the call failed.

booked_from.description: ISO date the place is booked from, if known.

distance_to_sea.description: Distance to the beach as the realtor gave it, in English, e.g. '300 m', '1-2 km', '5 min by bike'.

distance_to_sea_m.description: Distance to the beach in metres (lower bound of a range); null if given as travel time or unknown.

free_from.description: ISO date the place is free from, if known.

id.description: Property id; pass it to get_property.

listed_on.description: ISO date of publication (not a confirmation).

owner_confirmed_on.description: ISO date the OWNER last confirmed it is available. null = not confirmed; never promise availability.

price_month_inr.description: Monthly rent for the requested month (or the base rent), INR.

price_night_inr.description: Price per night, INR (short stays and hotels).

price_peak_inr.description: Monthly rent at peak (Christmas-New Year), INR.

type.description: 1RK, Studio, 1BHK...4BHK, House, Bungalow, Room, Villa, Hotel.

url.description: Telegram mini-app link: photos, video and a chat with the realtor.

title: Search rentals in Goa
